name: training-gfx1151-student-lora
description: Ax search space for the student LoRA training step (Qwen3.5-4B, bf16, PEFT LoRA r 16, TRL SFTTrainer) on pod D (Strix Halo, Radeon 8060S, gfx1151, ROCm 7.13, torch 2.9.1+rocm7.13.0, triton 3.5.1). Each parameter maps to one setting in lab/refine/research/kernels/settings_training_gfx1151.md; field names follow ax/api/configs.py (RangeParameterConfig, ChoiceParameterConfig, DerivedParameterConfig).

outcome_constraints.bound_rule: 0.8 x torch.cuda.mem_get_info() total on pod D, recorded by TS1; R39 fills the number before its first trial
baseline mean plus 3 x its run-to-run standard deviation from TS1, so a setting that breaks the math (for example packing on the torch Gated DeltaNet path) is rejected

fixed_effective_batch_size_note: Held fixed so the search changes speed, not the optimization recipe. 16 is Qwen's own fine-tuning example (batch 4 by accumulation 4, lab/refine/research/learning/lora_recipe.md section 1); L3 owns the real value and this field follows it.

parameters.name: gdn_kernel
parameters.setting: Gated DeltaNet chunk_gated_delta_rule: torch float32 reference or flash-linear-attention installed with --no-deps on the image's torch and triton

parameters.name: gradient_accumulation_steps
parameters.setting: SFTConfig.gradient_accumulation_steps, so per-device batch x accumulation stays at fixed_effective_batch_size

parameters.name: group_by_length
parameters.setting: train_sampling_strategy group_by_length on transformers main, the boolean group_by_length on older releases

parameters.name: aotriton_experimental
parameters.setting: TORCH_ROCM_AOTRITON_ENABLE_EXPERIMENTAL=1, letting SDPA use the AOTriton flash or efficient kernel on gfx1151 instead of math

parameters.name: torch_compile
parameters.setting: SFTConfig.torch_compile with the inductor backend and default mode

parameters.name: tunableop
parameters.setting: PYTORCH_TUNABLEOP_ENABLED=1 with PYTORCH_TUNABLEOP_TUNING=0, reading a results file tuned once per sequence length

parameters.name: causal_conv1d_kernel
parameters.setting: Gated DeltaNet short convolution: nn.Conv1d through MIOpen, or the causal-conv1d package built for gfx1151 with --no-build-isolation

parameters.name: blas_backend
parameters.setting: TORCH_BLAS_PREFER_HIPBLASLT=1; upstream 2.9.1 overrides it back to hipBLAS on gfx1151, so TS4 decides whether this stays in the space

invalid_combinations.why: the torch Gated DeltaNet path drops cu_seqlens, so packed examples share recurrent state (note section 6)

invalid_combinations.unless: a flash-attention variant TRL accepts loads on gfx1151
invalid_combinations.why: TRL warns of cross-contamination with SDPA (note section 9); until TS9's precondition holds, R39 fixes packing to false
packing already removes padding; length grouping adds nothing and changes example order
compile comes after fla so it does not compile a reference path about to be replaced (note section 12); allowed as a single control arm only

baseline_note: The smoke script runs accumulation 1 (effective batch 4); the pinned baseline uses accumulation 4 so it shares the search's fixed effective batch. TS1 runs both and records the difference.

pinned.model: Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B, AutoModelForCausalLM, dtype bfloat16, use_cache False
pinned.env_note: null means the variable is unset in every trial; R39 clears it explicitly so a pod profile cannot leak a value in.

excluded.why: compiled out on ROCm in torch 2.9.1, a no-op (note section 3)
the step is bf16 and TF32 is not supported on ROCm by default (note section 8)
LoRA's optimizer step is a small share; fused is already the default from torch 2.8 (note section 11)
batches are a few kilobytes of token ids; TS15 checks it is a no-op (note section 10)

excluded.setting: GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES and other HIP or HSA runtime variables
excluded.why: TS2 checks they are no-ops for a single-stream training step (note section 2)
only the torch conv path reaches MIOpen and its share is small; pinned to NORMAL, TS11 checks it (note section 7)

excluded.setting: use_kernels=True with the Atlas-Inference/gdn hub layer
excluded.why: third-party code with no documented backward pass; TS8 probes it first (note section 6)
a data choice owned by L3, not a speed setting
